links.outcome: Whether a priori bank sizing determined which paired-comparison conclusions were reachable
links.effect: Total architectural contrast resolved at 8.9 points with 97.7% realised power; orchestration-only contrast unresolved at 2.4 points, 13.3% power, needing ~1051 items. Of 13 contrasts, 5 resolved, 5 underpowered, 2 unresolvable, 1 hypothesis.
links.quote: Bank size, not the system under test, determined which conclusions were reachable.

unlisted_practices: Monte Carlo simulation-based sample-size calculation for paired McNemar benchmark comparisons
Reporting realised power and required bank size for every contrast including null ones
Assessing ceiling probability of benchmark banks
Pre-specified abstention probe using items without unanimous reference key agreement

screen.reason: The study develops and demonstrates a sample-size framework for paired clinical benchmarks (evaluating LLMs, neurosymbolic multi-agent systems, and physicians on dyslipidemia items), but does not evaluate a clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
